name: Self-Learning
description: At the end of each execution, evaluates if new knowledge was discovered and suggests documenting in steerings.

then.prompt: Evaluate the conversation that just ended. Only suggest documenting if the investigation was heavy (8+ interactions) or discovered an undocumented rule. If suggesting: indicate which steering, suggest exact content, ask for authorization. Never create/update without authorization. Reference: project-overview.md, code-conventions.md
